slides.title: Enter Saudi Arabia in 2027 through a retail partner, not alone
slides.subtitle: Board recommendation

slides.title: The market is big and growing, so enter with a partner in 2027

points.label: Large, young market
points.text: 36 million people, 60% under 35, steady appliance demand.

points.label: Steady growth
points.text: Appliance sales grew about 6% a year for three years.

points.label: Retail is concentrated
points.text: Extra and Saco sell most units, so access runs through them.

points.label: Partner is required
points.text: Distribution and after-sales service need a local partner.

slides.title: Four forces make Saudi attractive, and one makes entry hard

items.label: Young buyers
items.text: 60% of people are under 35 and set up new homes.

items.label: Heat drives cooling
items.text: Energy-efficient cooling sells well in summer.

items.label: Big retailers
items.text: Extra and Saco control shelf space.

items.label: Price pressure
items.text: Two Asian brands lead on price.

panel.heading: What this means for us
items: Win shelf space with one big retailer

slides.title: A retail partnership beats going alone or licensing
slides.takeaway: Recommended: a retail partnership with one leading chain.
